title: Template literal interface (ai`...`)
description:
## TDD: Template Literal Interface

Implement the `ai` tagged template literal for natural LLM invocation.

### Red Phase - Write Failing Tests First
```typescript
// tests/ai/template-literal.test.ts
import { ai } from '@dotdo/ai'

test('ai template literal returns AIPromise', async () => {
  const result = ai`Summarize: ${text}`
  expect(result).toBeInstanceOf(AIPromise)
})

test('ai template interpolates variables', async () => {
  const name = 'Alice'
  const result = await ai`Hello ${name}, how are you?`
  expect(result.prompt).toContain('Hello Alice')
})

test('ai template supports options', async () => {
  const result = ai`Generate code`.with({ model: 'claude-3-opus' })
  expect(result.options.model).toBe('claude-3-opus')
})
```

### Green Phase - Minimal Implementation
- Tagged template function that captures template strings and values
- Returns AIPromise (from do-7rf.5.2)
- Supports `.with()` for options chaining

### Refactor Phase
- Optimize string interpolation
- Add TypeScript overloads for type inference
- Reference: primitives/packages/ai-core for existing template implementation

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Failing tests written first
- [ ] ai\`...\` syntax works with interpolation
- [ ] Returns AIPromise for async handling
- [ ] Supports .with() chaining for options
- [ ] TypeScript types infer correctly
